name: OSS_COPY_MAP_OBJ_METADATA
description: This table stores the transformed view object specific copy map metadata at run time.

columns.name: OBJECT_METADATA_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier to store the metadata id of the object.

columns.name: MAPPING_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the name of copy map of the metadata row.

columns.name: TARGET_VO
columns.description: Full qualified view object name of the target view object.

columns.name: TARGET_TABLE
columns.description: Identifies the name of the target table.

columns.name: SOURCE_VO
columns.description: Full qualified view object name of the source view object.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Identifies the name of the source table.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the source object name in the corresponding copy map row.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Identifies the primary key attribute of the source view object.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN
columns.description: Identifies the primary key column of the source table.

columns.name: QUERY_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the query type for the metadata row. 1 - If using query attribute. ; 2 - If using Join view object , 3 - If blind query.

columns.name: QUERY_COLUMN
columns.description: Identifies the query column within the source table.

columns.name: JOIN_TABLE
columns.description: Identifies the table name to be used for join, if the query type is 2. Stores null for other query types.

columns.name: JOIN_COLUMN
columns.description: Identifies the column name to be used for join, if the query type is 2. Stores null for other query types.

columns.name: IN_MEMORY_FILTER
columns.description: Identifies the SQL equivalent corresponding to the in memory filter for the copy map view object row, if any.

columns.name: ORDER_OF_EXECUTION
columns.description: Identifies the order of execution.

columns.name: SELECT_QUERY_TEXT
columns.description: Identifies the final SQL to be used to select the records which would be later inserted to oss_batch_items table.

columns.name: COPY_MAP_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the user specific session identifier for a specific copy map action.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
